name: impeller_250g
description: Single-stage centrifugal impeller with splitters for a ~150-200 N micro-turbojet: 0.25 kg/s at 110,000 rpm, impeller PR 3.2.
notes: Shroud relative Mach just under 1 and tip Mach near 1.3: typical of small high-speed impellers.
Impeller pressure ratio only. Diffuser and volute losses reduce the stage ratio.
